name: Red7
summary: A card game where the rule for winning constantly changes and you must be winning at the end of your turn.
rules_text: 49 cards numbered 1-7 in seven spectrum colors Red Orange Yellow Green Blue Indigo Violet. Value beats color. Each player has a 7-card hand and a 1-card Palette. A Canvas card shows the current win rule. Red = highest card. Orange = most of one number. Yellow = most of one color. Green = most even cards. Blue = most different colors. Indigo = longest run. Violet = most cards below 4. Player left of current best starts. On your turn you must be winning by the Canvas rule at turn end. You may: play one card to your Palette, or discard one card to Canvas to change the rule (must be winning new rule after), or play to Palette then discard to Canvas (must be winning after). If you cannot or choose not to, you are eliminated. Last remaining player wins the round. With advanced scoring, winner banks Palette cards that satisfy the final rule as points; game ends when deck too small to deal.
rating_reason: Rule-changing card game, hidden hands, winning condition logic.
